description: Filter the Research Organization Registry (ROR) by organization type, country, and/or status to browse subsets of the 110,000+ global research organizations. Supports combining multiple filters with an optional keyword query. Organization types include: Education (universities, colleges), Healthcare (hospitals, clinics), Company (industry research), Archive (data repositories, libraries), Nonprofit (NGOs, foundations), Government (agencies, national labs), Facility (research infrastructures, telescopes), Funder (grant agencies, funding bodies), and Other. Country is specified as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (US, DE, GB, JP, CN, etc.). Returns total match count and up to 20 results per page with name, type, status, country, city, and website. Useful for generating lists of institutions in a specific country, enumerating funders by country, or counting research organizations by type.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter organizations by country (e.g. "US", "DE", "GB", "JP").

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed, default 1). Each page returns up to 20 results.

query.description: Optional keyword query to narrow results within the filter. Combines with type/country/status filters.

status.description: Organization status filter. Valid values: active (default), inactive, withdrawn. Use "inactive" or "withdrawn" to include legacy records.

types.description: Filter by organization type. Valid values: Education, Healthcare, Company, Archive, Nonprofit, Government, Facility, Funder, Other (e.g. "Education" returns universities and research institutes).

name: ror.organizations.filter

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.
